page_title: OSA 0-2 BET | Osasuna v Betis 05/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+3' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) muscles his way past two defenders but his shot from inside the box smashes against the crossbar! The ball goes out of play and Osasuna will have a goal kick.
90+1' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the net, but Rui Silva is alert and denies him.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
88' The game is interrupted. Jorge Herrando (Osasuna) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
86' Here's the change. Nabil Fekir leaves the pitch and Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) comes on as a substitute.
86' Victor Garcia has issued a yellow card to Rui Silva (Betis).
84' Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
83' Willian Jose (Betis) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
82' Substitution. Iker Munoz will be replaced by Xabi Huarte (Osasuna).
82' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to make a change. Juan Cruz (Osasuna) replaces Jesus Areso.
79' The resulting corner from Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
79' Ruben Pena (Osasuna) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The referee blows his whistle, Osasuna are awarded a corner kick.

77' Iker Munoz (Osasuna) latches on to a lofted pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a sweet strike. Unfortunately for him, the ball only rattles the right post. What a goal that would have been!
77' Rui Silva comes off his line to intercept the corner from Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna).
75' The attendance is 18300.
75' Rodri (Betis) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
74' Manuel Pellegrini decides to make a substitution. Pablo Fornals will be replaced by William Carvalho (Betis).
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Johnny Cardoso leaves the pitch and Rodri (Betis) comes on.
73' Jesus Areso (Osasuna) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
72' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Lucas Torro (Osasuna). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
70' The Osasuna players are exchanging some short passes.
68' Ayoze Perez (Betis) got the ball on the edge of the box and smashed a first-time shot, but his effort flew high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Osasuna will have a goal kick.
67' Flag up against Pablo Fornals (Betis). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
66' Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Raul Garcia.
66' Jagoba Arrasate prepares a substitution. Pablo Ibanez is replaced by Lucas Torro (Osasuna).
64' Abner (Betis) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him.
62' Substitution. German Pezzella walks off the pitch and Sokratis Papastathopoulos (Betis) comes on as a substitute.
61' Guido Rodriguez (Betis) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
59' That's an easy save for Rui Silva, following a first time shot towards the middle of the goal from Ruben Pena (Osasuna).
57' The resulting corner from Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) is cleared.

56' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) shows good awareness inside the box as he latches on to a cross from the resulting free kick. He jumps high but his towering header lacks a little bit of accuracy and glances off the crossbar.
55' Ayoze Perez (Betis) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Victor Garcia blows for a foul. That's a free kick to Osasuna.
54' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Pablo Fornals (Betis).

52' Ooh that was close! Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) collects a pass and runs with pace goalwards before unleashing a great drive from the edge of the box, but it goes inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.
52' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
51' Johan Mojica (Osasuna) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. The referee points to the corner flag and Osasuna will take a corner.
50' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
49' Nabil Fekir (Betis) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
48' Ruben Pena (Osasuna) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
46' Manuel Pellegrini makes a switch. Abner is coming on in place of Juan Miranda (Betis) at the start of the second period.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+8' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+8' German Pezzella (Betis) rises high to meet a cross from the corner kick and plants a header from inside the penalty area. His effort went just narrowly wide of the left post.
45+7' Nabil Fekir (Betis) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
45+7' Ayoze Perez (Betis) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Betis win a corner.
45+5' Nabil Fekir (Betis) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Pablo Fornals, but Sergio Herrera displays great awareness to stop him.
45+3' 0 - 2 It's in the back of the net! Willian Jose is the provider as he slips the ball to Pablo Fornals (Betis) who simply steers it home from close range. It's 0:2.
45+1' Willian Jose (Betis) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
45' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Osasuna.
42' Raul Garcia (Osasuna) attempts to discuss the decision with Victor Garcia, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.
41' Referee Victor Garcia has finally had enough of Jagoba Arrasate and gives him a straight RED CARD!
41' 0 - 1 Goal! Ayoze Perez (Betis) unleashes a first-time shot from inside the box and beats the goalkeeper low inside the middle of the net. 0:1.
41' Nabil Fekir (Betis) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
39' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
38' Today's referee Victor Garcia rightly decides to book Juan Miranda (Betis) for his harsh tackle.
37' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play.
37' The corner kick from Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders. Osasuna have been awarded a corner kick.
35' Victor Garcia blows his whistle. Willian Jose (Betis) commits a foul after dangerous play.
35' Juan Miranda (Betis) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Osasuna.
33' Youssouf Sabaly (Betis) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
32' Nabil Fekir (Betis) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
31' Ayoze Perez (Betis) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Betis have a corner.
29' Guido Rodriguez (Betis) commits a rough foul. Victor Garcia stops the game and makes a call.
26' It‘s a RED card, and quite right too after seeing the replay! Referee Victor Garcia had no choice but to send Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) off. VAR seen to good effect there!
25' Unai Garcia (Osasuna) gets a yellow card, off the field.
25' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident from earlier. This could be a red card for Jon Moncayola (Osasuna)! Let's see what he decides.
24' Victor Garcia shows a yellow card to Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) for a tough tackle.
22' The corner from Nabil Fekir (Betis) is cleared away by the defence.

21' That was close! Raul Garcia (Osasuna) makes a good run into the centre of the box and gets his head onto a lofted pass, but sends the ball a fraction over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.
20' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Victor Garcia blows his whistle for a foul.
19' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) swings the ball into the box from the corner kick but it's a bit too strong and it goes out of play.
18' A lofted cross from Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. Good work from Osasuna as they win a corner.
17' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) tries to find Ruben Pena, but he puts too much power on the through ball.

15' Johan Mojica (Osasuna) get himself out of a tight corner inside the box then shoots. The keeper leaps for the ball but it flies just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.
15' Nabil Fekir (Betis) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
14' Juan Miranda (Betis) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
12' Guido Rodriguez (Betis) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
11' Nabil Fekir (Betis) takes a short corner kick.

10' Great solo effort by Ayoze Perez (Betis) as he beats two defenders before firing in a drive from just outside of the box towards the left side of the goal. The goalkeeper is ready and makes an amazing save. Betis get a corner.
8' Ruben Pena (Osasuna) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.
6' Ayoze Perez (Betis) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
5' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
4' Ruben Pena (Osasuna) is flagged for offside.
2' Johnny Cardoso (Betis) takes the corner which is cleared.
1' The match has just started.
Osasuna will kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Victor Garcia.
